evidence.text: Phonosemantic compound. 广 represents the meaning and 占 represents the sound.
Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *tiːms): semantic 广 (“house built to depend on a cliff”) + phonetic 占 (OC *ʔljem, *tjems)

editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.
